scope: controlled 6-round reduced-key structural falsifier; no full-round claim
table: For each target evaluate the exact 16-bit syndrome for all 256x256 logical half-key pairs.
primary_exact_test: For syndrome word S[a,b], compute R[a,b]=S[a,b] xor S[a,0] xor S[0,b] xor S[0,0]. A syndrome bit is exact XOR-separable iff that bit of R is zero for all 65,536 cells.
match_rule: Using only the stable exact bit positions, derive half signatures from row0/column0 and count all (low,high) pairs satisfying the zero-syndrome signature condition; do not use the true key to choose bits.
secondary_diagnostics: GF(2) rank of each 256x256 syndrome-bit matrix
GF(2) rank of each centered residual bit matrix
real SVD effective rank of centered +/-1 bit matrices
stage1_only_if_primary_pass: Freeze fresh widths/targets and perform explicit MITM TOTAL accounting including half-table construction, matching, collisions and exact verification. No alpha<1 claim from this b16 structural pass alone.
kill_rule: If fewer than 8 identical syndrome bit positions are exact XOR-separable on all four fresh targets, or any target has >512 half matches under those frozen positions, close the simple 8+8 XOR-separable MITM family immediately.
forbidden: No target/split/layout/bit-position/threshold retuning after table inspection. Approximate/SVD structure cannot rescue a failed exact primary gate.
